findings.issue: Tech-spec Acceptance Criteria 'Outage state machine' explicitly demands 'All 12 state transitions from code-research §14.4 covered by tests (5 states × triggers)'. Task 5 TDD Anchor only lists 6 tests covering 4 transitions explicitly (no_outage→ping_1_sent, ping_1_sent→ping_2_sent, ping_2_sent→google_fallback_active, *→no_outage). The 'no-op' branches (e.g. ping_1_sent + outage error AND now-t0 < 1h → stays at ping_1_sent, no pings) and recovery_pending state probes are not anchored as tests, so a regression there would not be caught.
findings.fix: Add TDD Anchor entries (and corresponding AC line) covering: (a) ping_1_sent within 1h window — no advance, no extra ping; (b) ping_2_sent within 2h window — no advance, no fallback flip; (c) recovery_pending probe rate-limit via last_health_check_at; (d) recovery from google_fallback_active when fallback_active=1; (e) recovery_event when outage_started_at IS NULL (was_active=False) — already partially covered, make it explicit. Bring the count up to ~10–12 transition tests as tech-spec AC requires.

findings.issue: Decision 5 enumerates 7 API-level + 3 per-article anthropic SDK exception classes (10 total): APIConnectionError, APITimeoutError, RateLimitError, InternalServerError, AuthenticationError, PermissionDeniedError, NotFoundError, BadRequestError, UnprocessableEntityError, APIStatusError (unrecognized). Only the 9 named classes are covered.
findings.fix: Either (a) add `tests/test_claude_transcreation.py::test_unrecognized_api_status_raises_per_article` to TDD Anchor — synthetic `APIStatusError(status_code=418)` → `ClaudeTranscreationError`, OR (b) explicitly document in the AC that `APIStatusError` is the catch-all for non-listed status codes and confirm tech-spec '9 classes' matches the 9 listed. Bring the test inventory and Decision 5 enumeration into exact alignment.

findings.issue: AC 'В коде/документации зафиксировано: для outage admin-пингов использовать type(exc).__name__, не str(exc)' is satisfied by adding only a comment/docstring. Tech-spec AC under 'Token redaction & SDK loggers' is stricter: 'Admin-ping template uses type(exc).__name__ (not str(exc)) for user-visible messages on outage paths.' The task defers actual enforcement to downstream tasks (7, 8) without a test asserting any current admin-ping template uses the form. If downstream tasks miss the invariant, the redaction test won't catch it.
findings.fix: Either (a) add a test in this task that scans `news_bot.send_admin_notification`/related call sites for any plain `str(exc)` usage in outage-related templates and asserts none exist (lint-style), or (b) explicitly note in Post-completion that this AC is an invariant verified in Tasks 7 and 8 by their test suites, with a cross-reference. Avoid leaving the invariant as comment-only.
